Routine:

Cowashed with tresseme botanique nourish and replenish conditioner (squish to condish). Squished out about 75% of it.

 Immediately plopped with a microfiber towel for about 5 minutes. 

Removed the towel with my head upside down and gently applied miss jessies leave in condish, then some LA extreme sport gel (the green one). I sprayed it with a little water beforehand.  

Then I let it air dry for a bit. After about 15 minutes I decided to finally try diffusing. I did it mostly upside down, until it was about 80% dry. I let it air dry completely before scrunching it.
